cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Delete all PM2 processes and logs
print("=== Clearing PM2 ===")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 delete all")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("rm -f /var/log/areloria/*.log")
# Rebuild to be sure
print("=== Rebuild ===")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && pnpm run build 2>&1 | tail -5")
print(stdout.read().decode())
# Start with nohup to avoid caching
print("\n=== Starting fresh ===")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && nohup node server/dist/index.js > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &")
print("Started")
import time
time.sleep(5)
# Check if running
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ps aux | grep 'node server' | grep -v grep")
print("\n=== Process ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())
# Check log
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("tail -20 /tmp/server.log")
print("\n=== Server Log ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
PYEOF
